author: jih2nn
content: Thanks for your feedback. I've updated the [EIP PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12470) which would address your concerns regarding IL check rules, and left a comment with the link to your EthMag comment.

author: potuz
content: How does this address the RLP size limit? It seems to me that Pawel is right and you want an independent EIP to fix 7934 to just include the txs?

author: jih2nn
content: I said it addresses IL check rules concern. I didn't say that it addresses RLP size limit nor I want an independent EIP to fix it?

author: potuz
content: I may not be understanding Pawel's issue at all but the main point is that a tx can be "includable" but including that tx will result in a block with an invalid RLP size

author: potuz
content: If you fix the "includable" check then you fix the RLP size issue

author: jih2nn
content: There might be multiple ways to fix this and that's what I'd like to discuss to find out in this [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12470#discussion_r4654487278).
